purpose: Finite normalized directly declared public source surface of the existing 24 documented I/O owners; not a new capability denominator or complete SDK.

provenance.ordinary_settings: Loaded tutorial inherited settings; C# and Java generation selected separately; no application-wide default inferred.
provenance.binding: Retained historical generation manifests joined to HTTPS-origin installer-member byte matches. Original manifest acquisition caveats are superseded only for the selected generator and four inputs, not product-wide provenance.
provenance.audit: Fresh hashes of 13 ordinary and 13 wrapper files match both manifests and each other; original/staged inputs and five selected installer members rehashed. No new vendor operation.

anchoring: One-based LF-delimited lines (including final empty split item in lf_lines), zero-based source/type/member/parameter indexes. Declaration ranges exclude bodies and constructor initializers; getter anchors name tokens, not their bodies. Source type indexes count excluded top-level types too.
normalization: Type spelling and resolved names retain declaration facts only. Using/import tables and nested ownership resolve names; no implicit base/constructor is invented. Public accessor visibility is explicit or inherited from its property declaration. Nonconstant initializer values and runtime defaults are not established.

oracle.method: Independent manual transcription from numbered retained source reads and separate hash readback; no candidate JSON, cached discovery metadata or candidate lexer used to create expected rows.

manual_comparison.relationship: Separate source claims, not an automatic contradiction or a correction of the manual. Protected constructors are outside this public cohort; behavior remains unqualified.
